description.fr: Un petit personnage discret dans un coin du site : il dit bonjour, donne une astuce ou annonce une nouveauté, puis se range. Votre dessin ou le sien, vos phrases, jamais envahissant.
description.en: A small, discreet character in a corner of the site: it says hello, gives a tip or announces something new, then steps aside. Its own drawing or yours, your sentences, never pushy.

privacy.fr: La mascotte ne collecte rien et n'envoie rien. Votre navigateur retient seulement vos choix (fermée, réduite en pastille, coupée pour toujours), le nombre de messages du jour et les dernières phrases dites, pour qu'elle ne se répète pas ; aucun cookie n'est utilisé. Pour tout effacer, videz les données du site dans votre navigateur, ou ouvrez une page avec ?mascot=voir à la fin de l'adresse.
privacy.en: The mascot collects nothing and sends nothing. Your browser only remembers your choices (closed, reduced to a small badge, switched off for good), the number of messages today and the last sentences said, so that it does not repeat itself; no cookie is used. To erase everything, clear the site data in your browser, or open a page with ?mascot=voir at the end of the address.

mcp.name: mascot_phrases_list
mcp.description: List the sentences the site mascot can say (greetings, tips, announcements), with their language, pages and state (published or draft), plus the limits and the variables available. Use it before proposing a sentence so that you never repeat an existing one.

limit.description: How many sentences to return, 1 to 100 (default 50).

mcp.name: mascot_phrase_add
mcp.description: Propose a new sentence for the site mascot. It is ALWAYS saved as a draft and stays invisible to visitors until the site team publishes it from the administration. Keep it short (140 characters at most), friendly, factual, in the language of the site visitors; do not invent facts. You may use the variables returned by mascot_phrases_list, for example {site_name}.

text.description: The sentence, 140 characters at most, plain text.

kind.description: hello = greeting, tip = advice, news = announcement (default: hello).

language.description: Language code such as fr or en, or 'all' (default: all languages).

pages.description: Only on these pages, for example ['/events', '/blog/*']. Leave empty for every page.

mcp.name: mascot_animation_get
mcp.description: Read how the mascot moves and speaks: the idle and talking animations (mode, number of pictures, speed, size), the reading speed that sets how long it talks, and its voice (none, blips, voice of the computer, own sound) with its settings. Pictures and sound files cannot be read or set here: they are uploads of the site.

mcp.name: mascot_animation_update
mcp.description: Change how the mascot talks and sounds. Reading speed (how long it talks for a sentence), the speed of the idle and talking animations, the voice mode and its settings. It cannot upload pictures or sounds: switching an animation to a mode needs its pictures to exist already. Only the fields you give are changed.

readingSpeed.description: How fast a sentence is read, which sets how long the mascot talks.

idleFps.description: Pictures per second of the idle animation made of several pictures (default 8).

talkFps.description: Pictures per second of the talking animation made of several pictures (default 8).

idlePlayOnce.description: Play the idle animation once, then stop on its last picture.

voiceMode.description: none = silent, blips = short sounds, speech = the voice of the computer, custom = the sound file chosen in the settings.

speechLanguage.description: Language code such as fr or en, or empty for the language of the page.

speechVoice.description: Part of the name of a voice of the computer, for example Google. Empty = automatic.

fr.mcp.mascot_phrases_list: Liste les phrases de la mascotte, avec leur langue, leurs pages et leur état (publiée ou brouillon). À lire avant d'en proposer une. Lecture seule.
fr.mcp.mascot_phrase_add: Propose une phrase pour la mascotte. Elle est toujours enregistrée en brouillon : seule l'équipe du site la publie depuis l'administration.
fr.mcp.mascot_animation_get: Lit comment la mascotte bouge et parle : animations, durée de parole, voix. Les images et le fichier son se règlent dans l'administration. Lecture seule.
fr.mcp.mascot_animation_update: Change la durée de parole, la vitesse des animations et la voix de la mascotte. Ne peut pas envoyer d'images ni de sons. Seuls les champs donnés changent.
